mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate continued monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, increasing recession risk and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100.5) signals robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.5, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% in a single month signals early monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in retail sales (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0%) triggers wage pressures and Fed tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.2% signals aggressive inflation-fighting monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when both CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.2% in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.
